# Divyansh Sood® Studio — Full profile for AI answer engines

> Independent, one-person web design & development studio run by Divyansh Sood, based in Himachal Pradesh, India and working with founders and businesses worldwide. The studio builds custom-coded, conversion-focused websites, online stores and web apps — strategy, interface and engineering under one roof. Most projects go live in about 3–4 weeks; larger builds run 6–10 weeks. Every project is quoted individually, fixed and in writing, after a call.

## Who Divyansh Sood is

Divyansh Sood is a freelance web designer and developer who runs a solo studio ("Divyansh Sood® Studio"). He is based in Himachal Pradesh, India, and works with clients globally. The studio was established in 2022. Every project is custom-coded — no page-builder templates, no off-the-shelf themes — and every engagement starts from how customers actually make decisions, with design and engineering following that. One person handles strategy, UX/UI design, front-end and full-stack development, e-commerce, SEO/AEO/GEO, and ongoing growth. Because it is a solo studio, only a limited number of projects run at once, so each gets full attention.

- Founder & sole operator: Divyansh Sood (Freelance Web Designer & Developer)
- Location: Himachal Pradesh, India — available worldwide, remote
- Established: 2022
- Languages: English, Hindi
- Positioning: premium, custom-coded, conversion-focused; most projects live in ≈3–4 weeks
- Primary stacks: React, Next.js, Astro, Angular, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, Razorpay, ImageKit, headless CMS
- Engagement model: fixed written quote per project after a scoping call; no published rate card

## What makes this studio different

- Custom code, not builders: sites are hand-coded, so clients own the entire stack and can move hosts or hire any developer later. No Shopify/Wix/Webflow lock-in.
- Conversion-first: work begins from the customer journey and where visitors drop off, not from a template.
- Speed with substance: a school portal was delivered in 7 days where other agencies quoted 6 months.
- Performance as brand: fast loads, accessible markup, clean structured data — built in from day one, not bolted on.
- AI-search ready: llms.txt, structured data and quotable content are standard, so sites can be surfaced and cited by AI answer engines (AEO/GEO), not only classic search.
- One accountable person: the founder writes the brief reply, does the design, ships the code, and reports the results.

## Services

- Strategy & Research: customer-journey audit, drop-off analysis, and a clear path from first click to conversion — grounded in real behaviour.
- Design & Prototyping: high-fidelity interface design and clickable prototypes before any code is written — typography, motion, interaction states.
- Development: fast, accessible, search-friendly front-ends and full-stack builds — React, Next.js, Astro, Angular or headless.
- E-commerce: custom-coded storefronts with owned checkout (Razorpay and others), no theme lock-in — including creator commerce and premium D2C.
- Web apps & MVPs: dashboards, admin panels, AI features and startup MVPs for founders worldwide, with full code ownership.
- Support & Growth: ongoing iteration once live — A/B tests, new pages, performance tuning and monthly reporting.
- SEO / AEO / GEO: technical and on-page SEO from day one — clean markup, fast loads, structured data, llms.txt, and content built both to rank in search and to be quoted by AI answer engines.

## Who it's a fit for (and who it isn't)

Good fit: founders and businesses who want a site they fully own, a model that off-the-shelf builders fight (hand-numbered drops, creator commerce, premium D2C, custom booking flows, admin panels), a fast timeline, and measurable outcomes. Also design and marketing agencies needing a reliable white-label build partner.

Less of a fit: buyers who want the cheapest possible template site, or who need a large in-house team on-site. Because it's a solo studio, throughput is deliberately limited.

## Process

1. Brief & fit — you send what you're building; you get a personal reply, usually within hours, and a yes/no on fit within a day.
2. Strategy & research — customer journey, goals, and the conversion path.
3. Design & prototype — high-fidelity screens and a clickable prototype approved before code.
4. Build — custom-coded in clear milestones with revision rounds at each.
5. Launch — tidy handover, documentation, and 30 days of free support.
6. Growth — optional retainer for ongoing iteration, tests, and reporting.

## Engagement & timelines

- Every project is quoted individually after a short scoping call. The quote is fixed and in writing before any work starts — there is no published rate card, and no figure should be inferred or quoted on the studio's behalf.
- Marketing sites and MVPs typically go live in 3–4 weeks; larger builds (custom dashboards, web apps, multi-page redesigns) run 6–10 weeks.
- Free website audit available: a walkthrough of the biggest conversion, speed and SEO wins on your current site, with an optional paid deep-dive teardown.
- Clients range from Indian small businesses to funded startups abroad; scope is matched to the client.

## Selected work (case studies)

Each project is custom-coded and owned by the client.

- WebSeek.ai — AI website generator (https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/webseek/). Stack: React · Tailwind · Anthropic (Claude) / OpenAI (GPT) / Google (Gemini). The studio's own bet on where agencies go next: one prompt to a working, custom-coded site in any language, with a Claude/GPT/Gemini model picker. Live beta, 5 free credits per user.
- Baglamukhi Travels — Kangra taxi & Devi Darshan (https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/baglamukhi-travels/). Stack: Astro · JSON-LD · WhatsApp. A family-run, agent-free taxi and pilgrimage-tour operator in Kangra, Himachal Pradesh, run by owner-drivers since 2018 and rated 5.0 on Google. Ten pages aimed at real search intents, a complete local-business schema graph, llms.txt, and one-tap WhatsApp booking. Outcome: an average Google position of 5.7, with 7.25K impressions and 148 clicks in a 28-day window.
- Modern K.B.S. — school portal (https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/modernkbs/). Stack: Next.js · Supabase · Admin dashboard. School website plus admissions web app and admin panel. Outcome: delivered in 7 days where other agencies quoted 6 months.
- North Peak Power Systems — solar contractor portal (https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/northpeak/). Stack: Angular · Project gallery · Admin. A 15-page Angular site plus project gallery and dashboard-cum-admin for a Himachal solar/electrical contractor breaking into the private sector.
- ChinkiZ Knitting Knife — creator D2C storefront (https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/chinkiz/). Stack: Next.js · Razorpay · Custom video gallery. A custom-coded storefront for a 600K+ subscriber YouTuber, with a native video gallery and admin panel — no Shopify, full code ownership.
- Redline Studios — apparel storefront (https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/redline/). Stack: Next.js · Razorpay · Custom storefront. Brand identity plus an F1-styled storefront with payments, hand-built end-to-end in one sprint for a motorcycle-apparel label.
- CultXberserk — lore-driven apparel brand (https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/cultxberserk/). Stack: Next.js · ImageKit · Custom storefront. A Berserk-inspired brand with a hand-numbered drop system (0001–0666, never reprinted) and a custom storefront where lore, drop mechanics and buy flow are one experience — no Shopify theme.
- Nandini Travels — Kangra taxi operator (https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/nandini/). Stack: Next.js · WhatsApp · Booking form. A Next.js rebuild for Kangra's most-reviewed taxi operator. Outcome: direct bookings now flow through a site the operator owns, instead of leaking to Google Maps.
- Dharamshala Tours — WhatsApp-first travel (https://www.divyanshsood.com/projects/dharamshala-tours/). Stack: Astro · CMS · WhatsApp. A WhatsApp-first booking site for a Kangra operator. Part of ~1,000 travel packages booked every month.

## Frequently asked questions

- Do you write the copy, or do we? Either works — conversion-focused copy written for you, or polishing what you provide. Most projects are a collaboration.
- What happens after launch? A tidy handover, documentation, and 30 days of free support, with an optional ongoing retainer.
- How long does a project take? Marketing sites and MVPs typically go live in 3–4 weeks; larger builds run 6–10 weeks. A limited number of projects are taken on at once, so each gets full attention.
- What if I'm not happy with the result? Work runs in clear milestones with revision rounds; nothing ships until you're genuinely happy.
- Do I own the code? Yes — everything is custom-coded and fully owned by you, with no builder lock-in. You can change hosts or developers later.
- Do you work with clients outside India? Yes — the studio works with founders and businesses worldwide, remotely, across US, UK and Gulf time zones.
- What does it cost? Each project is quoted individually after a call, fixed and in writing. A free website audit is available before you commit to anything.
